_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: idx_batch_expiry
data.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_batch_expiry ON batches (expiry_date) WHERE quantity_on_hand > 0;

data.name: v_invoice_balance
data.sql: CREATE VIEW v_invoice_balance AS SELECT *, total_minor - paid_minor - credit_minor AS balance_minor FROM (SELECT i.id AS invoice_id, i.supplier_id AS supplier_id, i.invoice_date AS invoice_date, i.due_date AS due_date, i.total_minor AS total_minor, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_minor) FROM supplier_payments AS p WHERE p.invoice_id = i.id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS paid_minor, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount_minor) FROM supplier_credits AS c WHERE c.invoice_id = i.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS credit_minor FROM supplier_invoices AS i WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL)

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "suppliers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "contact_person" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "address" TEXT NULL, "tax_id" TEXT NULL, "payment_terms_days" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "medicines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "generic_name" TEXT NULL, "strength" TEXT NULL, "dosage_form" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other', "unit" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'piece', "pack_size" INTEGER NULL, "manufacturer" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NULL, "reorder_level" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "preferred_supplier_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "alert_window_days" INTEGER NULL, "storage_condition" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "search_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplier_invoices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "supplier_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "invoice_number" TEXT NULL, "invoice_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_date" TEXT NULL, "total_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "reminders_snoozed_until" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "batches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "medicine_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES medicines (id), "batch_number" TEXT NOT NULL, "expiry_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "expiry_precision" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity_received" INTEGER NOT NULL, "quantity_on_hand" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost_price_minor" INTEGER NULL, "selling_price_minor" INTEGER NULL, "received_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "supplier_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "invoice_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES supplier_invoices (id), "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE', "snoozed_until" TEXT NULL, "handled_at" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("medicine_id", "batch_number", "expiry_date"));
CREATE INDEX idx_batch_expiry ON batches (expiry_date) WHERE quantity_on_hand > 0

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplier_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "supplier_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "invoice_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES supplier_invoices (id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "paid_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NULL, "reference" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplier_returns" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "supplier_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "returned_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplier_credits" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "supplier_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "invoice_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES supplier_invoices (id), "return_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES supplier_returns (id), "amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "issued_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE VIEW v_invoice_balance AS SELECT *, total_minor - paid_minor - credit_minor AS balance_minor FROM (SELECT i.id AS invoice_id, i.supplier_id AS supplier_id, i.invoice_date AS invoice_date, i.due_date AS due_date, i.total_minor AS total_minor, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount_minor) FROM supplier_payments AS p WHERE p.invoice_id = i.id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS paid_minor, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(c.amount_minor) FROM supplier_credits AS c WHERE c.invoice_id = i.id AND c.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS credit_minor FROM supplier_invoices AS i WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_inv_due ON supplier_invoices (due_date)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_adjustments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES batches (id), "delta_qty" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "value_impact_minor" INTEGER NULL, "return_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES supplier_returns (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplier_return_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "return_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES supplier_returns (id), "batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES batches (id), "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "value_minor" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_batch_med ON batches (medicine_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_batch_supplier ON batches (supplier_id)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "medicine_barcodes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "medicine_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES medicines (id), "value" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "symbology" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_med_search ON medicines (search_text)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reorder_orders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "medicine_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES medicines (id), "supplier_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES suppliers (id), "quantity" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ordered_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "expected_on" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reorder_reminder_state" ("medicine_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES medicines (id), "last_notified_on" TEXT NULL, "snoozed_until" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("medicine_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduled_alerts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "fire_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "os_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "alert_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "body" TEXT NOT NULL, "route" TEXT NULL, "fired_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "opened_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX idx_alert_fire ON scheduled_alerts (fire_at)
